high_pass.description: Cut everything below a frequency: from 30 Hz (amount 0) up to 250 Hz (amount 1). Frees room for the parts that own the low end.

low_pass.description: Cut everything above a frequency: from 20 kHz (amount 0) down to 3 kHz (amount 1). Darkens and pushes a part back.

remove_mud.description: Cut the boomy low mids around 250 Hz, up to -8 dB.

remove_boxiness.description: Cut the hollow, boxy range around 500 Hz, up to -6 dB.

remove_harshness.description: Cut the piercing range around 3 kHz, up to -6 dB.

add_body.description: Boost around 150 Hz for weight, up to +5 dB.

add_presence.description: Boost around 5 kHz so a part cuts through, up to +5 dB.

add_air.description: Lift the top above 12 kHz with a high shelf, up to +6 dB.

gentle_compression.description: Even out a part: 2:1, slow attack, threshold down to -18 dB.

heavy_compression.description: Flatten a part's dynamics: 6:1, fast attack, threshold down to -30 dB.

glue.description: Bind a bus together: 2:1, slow attack, threshold down to -12 dB.

louder.description: Push a part or the master into the limiter: gain up to +9 dB, ceiling -0.3 dB.

small_room.description: A short, close room: 0.6 s decay, wet up to 35 %.

large_hall.description: A big space: decay from 2 s to 6 s, wet up to 45 %.

darker_reverb.description: Take the top off the reverb: high cut from 8 kHz down to 2 kHz.

brighter_reverb.description: Open the reverb's top: high cut from 6 kHz up to 16 kHz.

eighth_echo.description: Echoes on 8th notes, synced to the tempo; feedback and wet grow with amount.

dotted_echo.description: Echoes on dotted 8ths, synced to the tempo; feedback and wet grow with amount.

quarter_echo.description: Echoes on quarter notes, synced to the tempo; feedback and wet grow with amount.

vocal.description: Clean the lows, even out, a little room.

lead.description: Room for the low end, presence, echoes and space.

pad.description: Keep a wide part out of the lows and set it back.

bass.description: Tighten the low mids and even out the level.

drum_bus.description: Bind the drums on their bus.

master.description: Gentle glue and a ceiling for the whole mix.
